name: Tool Page & Comments Section
description: Renders individual tool documentation pages and a real-time comments section. ToolPage extracts toolSlug from React Router useParams, validates it with isToolSlug type guard, looks up the ToolDef from the constants registry, and renders the tool name heading, one-line description, StepBadge (step number pill), VersionBadge, step-by-step instructions with CodeBlock (dark terminal cards in JetBrains Mono), conditional VideoEmbed (YouTube iframe when tool has a video URL), and CommentsSection. CommentsSection uses Convex useQuery/useMutation for real-time comment listing and submission with client-side validation. Sub-components StepBadge, VersionBadge, CodeBlock, and VideoEmbed are pure presentational components kept under 300 lines each. Accent color from each tool's ToolDef is threaded through all themed sub-components via props.

functions.name: ToolPage
functions.description: Zero-prop route-level React page component. Extracts toolSlug from React Router useParams(), validates it via isToolSlug type guard, looks up the corresponding ToolDef from the constants registry, and renders the complete tool documentation page: tool name heading, one-line description, StepBadge, VersionBadge, step-by-step InstructionStep list rendered via CodeBlock components, conditional VideoEmbed (only when ToolDef.videoUrl is defined), and CommentsSection. Invalid or missing slugs render a not-found fallback view. The tool's accent color from ToolDef is threaded to all themed sub-components.

error_cases.name: invalid_slug
error_cases.condition: useParams().toolSlug is undefined or isToolSlug() returns false

error_data.behavior: Renders a not-found view with message indicating the tool was not found and a link back to the home page

error_cases.name: slug_not_in_registry
error_cases.condition: isToolSlug() returns true but TOOL_DEFS_BY_SLUG does not contain an entry for the slug

error_data.behavior: Renders a not-found view; this should not occur if isToolSlug and the registry are consistent

preconditions: Component is rendered inside a React Router <Route> with a :toolSlug path parameter
Convex provider is available in the React tree for CommentsSection's query/mutation hooks
TOOL_DEFS_BY_SLUG constant map is importable from the constants registry
postconditions: If toolSlug param is a valid ToolSlug and exists in TOOL_DEFS_BY_SLUG, renders the full tool documentation view with correct accent color, heading, description, badges, instruction steps, optional video, and comments section
If toolSlug param is undefined, empty, or not a valid ToolSlug, renders a not-found view with navigational guidance
StepBadge receives ToolDef.step and ToolDef.accentColor
VersionBadge receives ToolDef.version and ToolDef.accentColor
Each InstructionStep in ToolDef.steps is rendered as a CodeBlock with step.title and step.bash
VideoEmbed is rendered only when ToolDef.videoUrl is a non-empty string
CommentsSection receives the validated ToolSlug as page and ToolDef.accentColor

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function; all side effects are delegated to CommentsSection child component

functions.name: CommentsSection
functions.description: React component that renders a real-time comments list and a validated comment submission form for a specific tool page. Uses Convex useQuery(api.comments.listComments, { page }) for reactive comment loading and useMutation(api.comments.addComment) for submission. Manages local form state including author, body, submitting flag, and validation errors. Displays each comment with author name, body, and relative timestamp computed via formatRelativeTime. The submit button and section heading use the provided accent color.

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: The validated tool slug identifying which page's comments to query and submit to.

inputs.name: accentColor
inputs.description: Hex color string for accent styling on the submit button background and section heading text.

validators.error_message: accentColor must be a valid 6-digit hex color

error_cases.name: empty_author
error_cases.condition: User submits form with author field empty or whitespace-only after trimming

error_cases.name: empty_body
error_cases.condition: User submits form with body field empty or whitespace-only after trimming

error_cases.name: mutation_failure
error_cases.condition: Convex addComment mutation rejects (network error, server validation, rate limit, etc.)

error_data.behavior: Displays a generic error message below the form, re-enables the submit button, preserves form field values

error_cases.name: query_error
error_cases.condition: Convex useQuery for listComments throws or returns an error state

error_data.behavior: Displays an error message in place of the comment list, form remains functional

preconditions: Convex provider (ConvexProvider) is present in the ancestor React tree
api.comments.listComments query accepts { page: string } and returns CommentList
api.comments.addComment mutation accepts { page: string, author: string, body: string }
page is a validated ToolSlug (caller has already verified via isToolSlug)
postconditions: While useQuery returns undefined (loading), renders a loading indicator
When useQuery returns CommentList, renders each Comment with author, body, and formatRelativeTime(comment.createdAt)
Comment list is ordered by createdAt descending (newest first), as returned by the query
Submission form contains a text input for author, a textarea for body, and a submit button
Submit button is disabled and shows loading state while submitting is true
On form submit: trims author and body, validates non-empty, sets validationErrors if invalid, otherwise calls addComment mutation
On successful mutation: resets author and body to empty strings, clears validationErrors
On mutation error: sets a generic submission error and re-enables the form

structured_side_effects.description: Reactive subscription to the comments list for the given tool page; re-renders automatically when comments change on the server
Sends a new comment (author, body, page) to the Convex backend on form submission
Manages local form state: author string, body string, submitting boolean, and validationErrors object

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n is the number of comments rendered

structured_side_effects.description: Pure presentational component with no side effects

functions.name: VideoEmbed
functions.description: Pure presentational React component rendering a responsive YouTube iframe embed. Wraps the iframe in an aspect-video container (Tailwind aspect-video class) for responsive 16:9 sizing. The parent component is responsible for conditional rendering — VideoEmbed always receives a valid URL and is never rendered with an absent URL.

inputs.description: Full YouTube embed URL. Parent guards optionality; this prop is always a valid embed URL.

validators.error_message: URL must be a valid YouTube embed URL

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Accessible title attribute for the iframe element, used by screen readers and displayed on hover.

validators.error_message: Title must be between 1 and 200 characters

preconditions: url is a valid YouTube embed URL (parent has validated before rendering this component)
This component is only rendered when the tool has a non-null videoUrl in its ToolDef
postconditions: Renders a wrapper div with Tailwind class aspect-video for responsive 16:9 aspect ratio
Contains an iframe element with src set to the url prop
iframe has title attribute set to the title prop for accessibility
iframe has width='100%' and height='100%' to fill the aspect-ratio container
iframe includes allow='accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture' and allowFullScreen attributes
iframe has frameBorder='0' for clean rendering

structured_side_effects.description: Pure presentational component; the iframe itself loads external content but this is standard browser behavior, not an application-level side effect

functions.name: isToolSlug
functions.description: TypeScript type guard function that validates whether an arbitrary string value is a member of the ToolSlug union type. Returns true (narrowing the type to ToolSlug) if the value matches one of the known tool slug literals from the canonical type registry, false otherwise. Used by ToolPage to validate the useParams() output before looking up the ToolDef.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Arbitrary string to test for membership in the ToolSlug union type.

postconditions: Returns true if and only if value is one of the string literals in the ToolSlug union type
When true is returned, TypeScript narrows the type of value to ToolSlug (value is ToolSlug)
Returns false for empty strings, undefined coerced to string, and any string not in the ToolSlug set

structured_side_effects.description: Pure predicate function with no side effects

functions.name: formatRelativeTime
functions.description: Pure utility function that converts a Unix millisecond timestamp (as returned by Convex _creationTime or a custom createdAt field) into a human-readable relative time string. Used by CommentsSection to display comment ages. Output strings follow the pattern: 'just now' (< 60s), '{n} minute(s) ago', '{n} hour(s) ago', '{n} day(s) ago', '{n} week(s) ago', '{n} month(s) ago', '{n} year(s) ago'. Singular/plural forms are grammatically correct.

inputs.name: createdAt
inputs.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds representing when the comment was created.

validators.error_message: createdAt must be a non-negative Unix timestamp in milliseconds

error_data.message: createdAt must be a non-negative Unix timestamp in milliseconds

preconditions: createdAt is a non-negative integer representing milliseconds since Unix epoch
createdAt is not in the future relative to Date.now() under normal operation
postconditions: Returns 'just now' when the difference from Date.now() is less than 60 seconds
Returns '{n} minute(s) ago' for differences between 60 seconds and 60 minutes
Returns '{n} hour(s) ago' for differences between 60 minutes and 24 hours
Returns '{n} day(s) ago' for differences between 24 hours and 7 days
Returns '{n} week(s) ago' for differences between 7 days and 30 days
Returns '{n} month(s) ago' for differences between 30 days and 365 days
Returns '{n} year(s) ago' for differences of 365 days or more
Uses singular form ('1 minute ago') when n === 1, plural form ('2 minutes ago') when n > 1
If createdAt is in the future (clock skew), returns 'just now' rather than negative values

structured_side_effects.description: Pure function; reads Date.now() for current time but has no side effects

invariants: All six sub-components (ToolPage, CommentsSection, StepBadge, VersionBadge, CodeBlock, VideoEmbed) are React functional components with TypeScript type annotations on all exports
No class components are used anywhere in this component tree

Each source file remains under 300 lines; the six components are in separate files: src/pages/ToolPage.tsx, src/components/CommentsSection.tsx, src/components/StepBadge.tsx, src/components/VersionBadge.tsx, src/components/CodeBlock.tsx, src/components/VideoEmbed.tsx
isToolSlug is defined in a shared utils file (e.g. src/utils/typeGuards.ts) and imported by ToolPage
formatRelativeTime is defined in a shared utils file (e.g. src/utils/formatRelativeTime.ts) and imported by CommentsSection
Accent color is never hardcoded in sub-components; it is always received via props and applied via inline style objects, never via Tailwind arbitrary value classes
VideoEmbed is conditionally rendered by ToolPage only when ToolDef.videoUrl is defined and non-empty; VideoEmbed itself never checks for URL presence
CommentsSection never directly imports or references ToolDef or the constants registry; it receives only the ToolSlug page identifier and accentColor
The ToolSlug, ToolDef, HexColor, StepNumber, InstructionStep, Comment, and CommentList types are imported from the canonical type registry, never redefined in this component
All Tailwind classes are used for styling; no custom CSS files are introduced
CodeBlock renders bash content as text content (textContent/children), never via dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Convex hooks (useQuery, useMutation) are imported from 'convex/react' per project preferences
Comment form inputs are validated client-side (non-empty after trimming) before calling the Convex mutation

data_access.rationale: Reads PUBLIC data: tool definitions (name, description, version, steps, videoUrl, accentColor) from the constants registry are static public content. Reads INTERNAL data: comment list via Convex useQuery(api.comments.listComments) returns user-submitted comments (author name, body, timestamp) which are user-generated content displayed publicly but stored internally. Writes PUBLIC data: submits new comments via Convex useMutation(api.comments.addComment) with author name and body text, which become publicly visible on the page.

side_effects.rationale: CommentsSection subscribes to api.comments.listComments with the page parameter, receiving real-time updates of all comments for the current tool page including author names, comment bodies, and creation timestamps
CommentsSection calls api.comments.addComment to persist a new comment with the user-provided author name and body text associated with the current tool page slug
